## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it is needed.

## Checks

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run build`, and `npm pack --dry-run` pass.
- [ ] JSON v1 changes update the schema, synthetic fixtures, adapter contract, and README (or explain why not).
- [ ] No private baseline, inventory, names/handles, source data, credentials, or customer documentation were added.
- [ ] Generated JSON/HTML is published only with explicit audience/privacy approval.
- [ ] Signed commits and required review are in place; all review threads are resolved.
